summary: Implemented a fail-closed Alpha rootfs validator for package-default staging. The validator checks policy pack, semantic tool manifest, ModelBroker config, and persistent runtime state directories, emits stable JSON, records artifact IDs and host paths, verifies owner/mode intent, checks hashes for files, rejects secret-like values, and fails when required artifacts are missing.

validation_modes.PackageDefaults: Validates source-controlled Alpha package defaults and persistent state directory placeholders.
validation_modes.FullRootfs: Adds future full-image checks for agentd boot/runtime paths and release metadata.

verification.fail_fixture_command: copy packaging/agentos/rootfs to .workflow/artifacts/alpha-rootfs-validation/missing-model-rootfs, remove etc/agentos/model-broker.toml, then run scripts/validate-alpha-rootfs.ps1
verification.generated_artifacts_policy: Validation output and temporary failing fixtures stay under .workflow/artifacts/ and are not committed.

acceptance_evidence.fail_closed_missing_artifacts: Missing model_broker.config produces a failed validation result with failed_ids=[model_broker.config].
acceptance_evidence.stable_json: The validator writes agentos.alpha-rootfs-validation.v1 JSON with artifact IDs, paths, checks, summary, and result.
acceptance_evidence.offline: PackageDefaults validation uses only local files and does not require network or external LLM access.
